about: 0x07 on an attached connection re-arms the session: besides the size jiggle, the server sends SIGURG to its own dch client, which (1.58.0+) attaches again so the master re-sends the session's terminal modes, then repaints. So 0x07 brings more 0x10 output after the attach's repaint has drained (dch 1.58.0 serve.c:1815-1829, attach.c:213-224 and :1134-1149, master.c:3863-3930; Prosper #885). Mutating: it starts golden-885.
